scope: Independent fixed-budget response prediction and mixture validation for the declared numerically stopped process; no guaranteed precision, continuum or calibrated cluster claim

reporting.family_inventory: 9 response intervals, 15 validation shifts, 15 prediction residuals, 6 response refinement contrasts and 6 endpoint refinement contrasts. Scaled small-a remainders reuse the residual event.
reporting.boundary_method: One-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound on P(B>0), multiplied by known support maximum 2N for a response quartet or 2 for a validation pair. Finite-sample mean allowance also retained; a zero observed allowance is not zero population uncertainty.
reporting.joint_scope: Normal family has approximate coverage, continuation family exact binomial coverage up to numerical evaluation. Split alpha reserves total nominal 0.05; no exact joint finite-sample guarantee for normal comparisons.
reporting.classification: Intervals wholly within tolerance: within_tolerance; wholly outside: outside_tolerance; otherwise inconclusive. Classification concerns only the declared numerically stopped finite-step process.
reporting.continuum_gate: Requires sampling, grid/time sensitivity and population continuation bounds to meet their respective budgets, plus independent convergence/calibration evidence. A finite refinement contrast is not a continuum-error proof.
reporting.tails: Retain extrema, top absolute-score shares and centered-square variance concentration; all scores included. Normal intervals remain approximate with rare influential contributions.
reporting.adaptation: No counts, thresholds, cutoffs, launch conditions or confidence families changed in response to outcomes
